dimensions.assessment: Effects are administrative and procedural, focused on testing AI tools and reporting data back to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: describe the aggregate amount of improper refunds or reduced tax liability attributable to fraud detected

dimensions.assessment: No new funding or spending levels are stated beyond the execution of the pilot program within existing operations.
Requires a specific temporary pilot program and reporting mandates for federal agencies without altering broader tax statutes.
dimensions.evidence: establish a pilot program to use artificial intelligence to identify inaccurate returns of tax

dimensions.assessment: The pilot program operates for a fixed period of 18 months to 2 years.
dimensions.evidence: shall operate for a period of not less than 18 months and not more than 2 years.

missing_information: Specific financial costs or budgetary allocations for establishing the AI pilot program.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates a temporary pilot program using artificial intelligence to identify inaccurate federal tax returns and requires a subsequent report to Congress, resulting in limited and administrative federal effects.
